doc: Sets flags bit 0x8000 on 4 entries (of a 6-byte struct table pointed to by D_8008333C.field0) for each party-slot index i in [10,12): entries at byte offsets (i << D_8008333C.field14)*6 + {0x78,0x7E,0xFC,0x102}. Sibling func_80043A68 clears the same bit (&= 0x7FFF) over the identical index set — same struct, same idiom.
